name: pig-ladder
comment: WP-2.2. Stone platform y = 60 over -8..8 with the one-high rim; a stone wall x -1..1, y 61..75, z 1 and a ladder column (id 65, meta 2: its 0.125 box against the wall at z + 1) at x 0, y 61..74, z 0. A pig (id 0) dropped at (0.5, 80, 0.4), just clear of the ladder box: it falls 5 blocks, then EntityLiving.isOnLadder (the block at the feet) holds in moveEntityWithHeading's air branch: motion clamped to +-0.15 horizontally and >= -0.15 down, fallDistance reset every tick, so it lands with no fall damage (EntityLiving.fall: ceil(0 - 3) <= 0); pushed into the wall while on the ladder (isCollidedHorizontally) it climbs (motionY = 0.2). Then it wanders off. rng_state and entity_state every tick.
